content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The remuneration per month is Rs. 1,50,000/- for candidates with a Post Graduate Degree and Rs. 1,20,000/- for candidates with a Post Graduate Diploma across the applicable medical officer posts. For the Dental Surgeon (Prosthodontist and Implantologist) post, the remuneration is Rs. 1,50,000/-. The service is purely on a contractual basis for a period of one year, renewable subject to satisfactory performance. Performance will be reviewed after three months of the contract, and if work is not found satisfactory, the contract may be terminated without any notice. Successful candidates must execute a contractual agreement and a one-year bond with DMFT. Candidates must have a valid Medical Council of India (MCI) or Dental Council of India (DCI) registration. The eligible age limit of candidates is between 23 to 64 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHS Godda Specialist Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Download the application form available on the official district website at https://godda.nic.in. Fill out all mandatory fields in the application form accurately. Attach a recent self-attested passport-size photograph and self-attested photocopies of all required educational, caste, residential, and experience documents. Pack the application form and documents inside a sealed envelope. Write the specific "Post Code .................... & Post Name ...................." in bold letters on top of the envelope. Submit the completed application by hand, registered post, or speed post to the Civil Surgeon Office, Godda, In front of Mela Maidan, Godda, Jharkhand, 814133 on or before 22.10.2026 at 05:00 pm.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Resume All Educational mark sheets and Certificates (10th, 12th, MBBS, PG Diploma / Specialization / equivalent certificates) Caste Certificate (for those wishing to apply under reserved quota issued by the competent authority of Jharkhand State) Residential Certificate (for those wishing to apply under reserved quota) Experience Certificate (if applicable, corroborated with pay slips, bank account statement, or income tax return statements) Recent Passport size Photo (04 copies) Copy of PAN & AADHAR card Any other relevant Certificate / Testimonial / Letter of recognition or appreciation No Objection Certificate (NOC) from employer at the time of joining, if presently working in Health & Family Welfare Department / DMFT / NHM either on regular or contractual basis

faq.question: Q1. Is this DHS Godda Specialist Medical Officer job permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The service is purely on a contractual basis for a period of one year, renewable subject to satisfactory performance. Any claim for absorption in a regular position in the District Mineral Foundation Trust, Godda will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q2. What are the age limits and age criteria for applicants?
faq.answer: The age of candidates must be between 23 and 64 years.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to claim reservation benefits under this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates of Jharkhand State claiming reservation in their respective categories (ST, SC, BC-1, BC-2 & EWS) must submit the Caste Certificate in the prescribed format issued by the competent authority of Jharkhand State.

faq.question: Q4. Can currently employed candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates who are presently working in the Health & Family Welfare Department, DMFT, or NHM on a regular or contractual basis are eligible to apply, but they must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q5. What documents are needed to verify post-qualification experience?
faq.answer: Experience must be from a government-recognized or registered hospital and corroborated with one or a combination of pay slips, bank account statements, or income tax return statements.
